channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: What you should and shouldn't do if your part of France is under a flood warning
item.description: Floods are the leading natural disaster affecting France, that regularly cause deaths to members of the public. Here's the crucial advice to follow if you are caught in a flood where you live.

item.title: LATEST: French Riviera placed on alert for coastal flooding and high winds
item.description: Parts of the French riviera and Corsica were placed on Orange alert for coastal flooding on Friday with high tides and strong winds expected. Parts of Brittany and western France also remained on flood alert.

item.title: La Belle Vie: Where to go to furnish your French home and the unwritten rules of a 'brocante'
item.description: From famous French flea markets to moving to somewhere sunny and dreaming of living on an island off the French coast - this week’s La Belle Vie newsletter offers an essential starting point for eating, talking, drinking, and living like a local.

item.title: French property grant scheme 'MaPrimeRénov' set to reopen
item.description: France's MaPrimeRénov scheme, which helps households finance green home improvement projects, is set to resume in February after being suspended at the start of the year.

item.title: French expression of the day: donner du fil à retordre
item.description: This French expression is not just about weaving and twisting thread...

item.title: Danone recalls baby formula in several European countries
item.description: French food giant Danone has enlarged its recall of infant formula to Austria, France, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Romania and Switzerland, the company and national health authorities said.

item.title: France detects Russia-linked Epstein smear attempt against Macron
item.description: France has detected a Russia-linked disinformation effort alleging President Emmanuel Macron's involvement with sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, a government source told AFP on Friday.

item.title: How to watch the 2026 Winter Olympics on French TV
item.description: A year and a half after the Paris 2024 Olympics Games, how can sports fans in France catch all the action from the Winter Olympics, in Milano Cortina, Italy?

item.title: Could you be exempt from paying France's taxe foncière in 2026?
item.description: Certain homeowners in France, because of age or income, or if they are in receipt of certain benefits, may be exempt from paying the annual property tax in 2026, or entitled to a reduction.

item.title: What's at stake in the key local election battle in the French Riviera city of Nice?
item.description: With France's municipal elections coming up in March, the Riviera city of Nice has become the stage for a showdown between two rival stalwarts from the right of French politics.
